name: Azure AI Foundry
summary: Azure AI Foundry resource with model deployments (Azure OpenAI and other models), Foundry projects, Entra ID only auth and private networking.
useWhen: You need Azure OpenAI or other Foundry model deployments
You need a Foundry resource with projects for agents and evaluations
avoidWhen: You need the full Foundry landing zone with Cosmos DB, AI Search and Storage dependencies for agent standard setup (use an AVM pattern module for that landing zone instead)
